info.title: ReaSock
info.description: JSON-RPC 2.0 over WebSocket between REAPER and outside programs. Each running REAPER announces itself in `~/.reasock/instances/<pid>.json`. After connecting, a client must call `initialize` before anything else except `rpc.discover`. Params are always by name. Messages the server sends to clients on its own (registered actions running, and subscribed events) are listed under `x-notifications`. Scripts inside REAPER use the same protocol through the ReaScript functions listed under `x-reascript`.

servers.name: local
servers.summary: A REAPER instance on this machine

port.description: Read the actual port from the instance file.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Must be the first call on a connection. The server always answers with its own `protocolVersion`; if that differs from the client's, the client decides whether to continue.

params.name: capabilities
params.description: Reserved for features the client opts into. Currently ignored.

methods.name: rpc.discover
methods.description: Returns the OpenRPC document describing this server.

methods.name: action.register
methods.summary: Add an action to REAPER's action list
methods.description: Registers `_REASOCK_<client>_<id>` in the main section. Users can bind it to keys, menus, and toolbars, and those bindings survive restarts. When it runs, this connection receives `action.triggered`. Registering an id this connection already owns returns the existing action. Actions are removed when the connection closes. Always refer to actions by `command`; `commandId` can change between REAPER sessions.

params.name: label
params.description: Shown in the action list as `ReaSock (<client>): <label>`.

methods.name: action.unregister
methods.summary: Remove one of this connection's actions

methods.name: action.run
methods.description: Runs a built-in action by numeric ID (for example 40182, Item: Select all items) or any named action that is currently in the action list.

methods.name: events.subscribe
methods.description: Adds events to this connection's subscriptions, replacing the options of any it already has. Right after subscribing (or changing options), the connection receives the event once with the current state; after that, only when the state changes. State is checked about 30 times per second, and bursts of changes arrive as one notification per check. Collection events accept `CollectionOptions`.

methods.name: transport.get
methods.summary: Get the play, pause, and record state

methods.name: items.list
methods.summary: Get all items, or one track's, a page at a time
methods.description: Items come in REAPER's order: by track, then position.

params.name: track
params.description: GUID of a track, to list only its items.

methods.name: items.listSelected
methods.summary: Get the selected items, a page at a time

methods.name: tracks.list
methods.summary: Get all tracks, a page at a time
methods.description: In order. The master track is not included.

methods.name: tracks.listSelected
methods.summary: Get the selected tracks, a page at a time
methods.description: The master track is never included.

methods.name: markers.list
methods.summary: Get markers and regions, a page at a time

methods.name: debug.stats
methods.description: Reports how much of REAPER's main thread Tell is using, per timer tick and per event.

params.name: reset
params.description: Start a new measurement window after reading.

x-notifications.name: action.triggered
x-notifications.summary: One of this connection's actions ran
x-notifications.description: Sent to the connection that registered the action, whether it ran from a key, a menu, the action list, or `action.run`.

params.name: id
params.description: The id the action was registered with.

x-notifications.name: transport.changed
x-notifications.summary: Play, pause, or record state changed

x-notifications.name: project.changed
x-notifications.summary: A different project is current, or the current one was saved or became dirty
x-notifications.description: Fires on tab switches, opening, saving, save-as, and the first edit after a save. Subscribe with `events.subscribe`.

params.name: name
params.description: File name without extension, or null until the project is saved.

params.name: path
params.description: Path of the project file, or null until the project is saved.

x-notifications.name: project.edited
x-notifications.summary: An undoable change happened in the current project

params.name: stateChangeCount
params.description: Increases with every change to the project.

params.name: lastUndo
params.description: Description of the most recent undo point, for example "Move media items".

x-notifications.name: items.selectionChanged
x-notifications.summary: The item selection changed, or a selected item changed
x-notifications.description: Fires when items are selected or deselected, and when a selected item is moved, trimmed, or renamed (including live, while dragging). The first notification after subscribing lists every selected item as added. When `truncated` is true, catch up with `items.listSelected`. Subscribe with `events.subscribe`.

params.name: added
params.description:
GUIDs newly selected. Omitted, like `removed` and `changed`,
when the change is larger than the subscription's `limit`.

params.name: changed
params.description: GUIDs still selected whose details changed.

params.name: items
params.description:
Full entries, per the subscription's `include` option, in
selection order.

params.name: truncated
params.description:
Something this subscription asks for was left out because it
exceeded `limit`. Page through the selection to catch up.

x-notifications.name: tracks.selectionChanged
x-notifications.summary: The track selection changed, or a selected track changed
x-notifications.description: Works like `items.selectionChanged`; catch up with `tracks.listSelected`. The master track is never included. Subscribe with `events.subscribe`.

params.name: added
params.description:
GUIDs newly selected. Omitted, like `removed` and `changed`,
when the change is larger than the subscription's `limit`.

params.name: changed
params.description: GUIDs still selected whose details changed.

params.name: tracks
params.description:
Full entries, per the subscription's `include` option, in
selection order.

params.name: truncated
params.description:
Something this subscription asks for was left out because it
exceeded `limit`. Page through the selection to catch up.

x-reascript.name: ReaSock_Open
x-reascript.description: Opens a local ReaSock connection and initializes it as `client` (1-32 letters or digits). Returns the connection, or 0 if that failed. A connection that goes 10 seconds without a Call or Poll is closed.

x-reascript.name: ReaSock_Call
x-reascript.description: Runs one ReaSock method with JSON params and returns the JSON-RPC response, with either `result` or `error`.

x-reascript.name: ReaSock_Send
x-reascript.description: Sends any JSON-RPC message or batch. Replies arrive through ReaSock_Poll. Returns false if the connection is closed.

x-reascript.name: ReaSock_Poll
x-reascript.description: Returns the next waiting message (a reply, event, or action.triggered), or an empty string.

x-reascript.name: ReaSock_Close
x-reascript.description: Closes a local connection, removing its actions and subscriptions.

x-reascript.name: ReaSock_OpenDocs
x-reascript.description: Opens the bundled ReaSock API reference in the default browser. Returns false if it isn't installed.

selectedItems.description: Up to the first 256 selected items.

truncated.description:
More items are selected than `selectedItems` holds; use
`items.listSelected` for the rest.

ActionContext.description: Selected items when an action runs, capped like selection notifications.

include.description: Which full entries to send. Defaults to `changed`.

limit.description: The most GUIDs or entries one notification may carry. Defaults to 256.

CollectionOptions.description:
Options for collection events (`items.selectionChanged`,
`tracks.selectionChanged`). Notifications never carry more than `limit`
GUIDs or entries; anything left out is flagged with `truncated`.

CommandRef.description: A command ID, such as 40182, or a named command, such as `_SWS_ABOUT`.

ticks.description: Per timer tick: snapshots, comparisons, and serializing notifications.

DebugStats.description: How much of REAPER's main thread Tell is using. Times are in microseconds.

Empty.description: A result with nothing to report.

EventName.description: An event a client can subscribe to; also its notification method name.

check.description: The cheap change check, every tick.

snapshot.description: Full snapshots, only when the check shows a change.

lastBytes.description: Size of the most recent notification.

oneOf.description: Entries that were added or changed.

Include.description: Which full entries a collection notification carries.

connection.description: This connection's number, unique while REAPER runs.

path.description: Source file of the active take, or null for MIDI and empty items.

takeCount.description: How many takes the item has; see `takes.list`.

Item.description: A media item. `guid` is stable across sessions.

ItemsFound.description:
Result of `items.get`: each entry in the same position as its GUID, or
null if there is no such item.

guid.description:
Stable across sessions once the project is saved (REAPER 7 assigns
GUIDs to markers and regions when a project is loaded).

number.description: The number shown in REAPER. Markers and regions are numbered separately.

end.description: Where a region ends, in seconds; null for markers.

name.description: File name without extension, or null until the project is saved.

path.description: Path of the project file, or null until the project is saved.

commandId.description: Numeric ID for this REAPER session only.

Subscription.description: An event name, or an event with options.

path.description: Source file, or null for MIDI and empty takes.

active.description: Whether this is the item's active take.

startOffset.description: Seconds into the source where the take starts playing.

Take.description: A take of a media item. `guid` is stable across sessions.

Track.description: A track. `guid` is stable across sessions.

ActionConflict.message: the action is owned by another connection

UnknownAction.message: this connection has no action with that id

NotFound.message: nothing in the current project has that GUID
